objectives.title: Represent a Goose in Court
objectives.task: defend a goose accused of impersonating the mayor

climax.text: The judge asks your client to confirm it is not the mayor. The goose produces a sash, a manifesto, and excellent polling numbers.

choices.label: Establish that the mayor was always a goose
choices.win: The old portraits are conclusive. Three generations of honking public service.
choices.lose: The judge is also in the portraits. He requests a recess and a weapon.

onWin.memory: You proved the mayoral office had been hereditary goose territory for generations.

choices.label: Campaign for immediate electoral legitimacy
choices.win: A snap election. The goose wins on lower bread prices. Democracy survives, noisily.
choices.lose: The goose eats the ballots. The opposition has questions.

onWin.memory: Your goose client won a snap election on lower bread prices.

choices.label: Keep the client from eating the verdict
choices.win: The verdict remains legible long enough to acquit. The goose eats the gavel instead.
choices.lose: Your client swallows the acquittal. You are held in contempt of goose.

onWin.memory: You saved the goose's acquittal at the cost of the judge's gavel.

objectives.title: Exorcise the Self-Checkout
objectives.task: remove a ghost from a shop till that keeps demanding an unexpected item in the bagging area

climax.text: The till announces: 'Unexpected soul in bagging area.' It means yours. The ghost asks whether you have a loyalty card for the afterlife.

choices.label: Process the ghost as a return with no receipt
choices.win: Store credit in the afterlife. The ghost accepts. It always wanted options.
choices.lose: The till calls a supervisor. The supervisor is a much older ghost.

onWin.memory: You exorcised a checkout by refunding its ghost in afterlife store credit.

choices.label: Perform the sacred reboot sequence
choices.win: Off. On. Peace. A priest watching through the window changes careers.
choices.lose: The reboot requires a supervisor's fingerprint. The supervisor has been dead since 1842.

onWin.memory: A sacred reboot ended the checkout haunting and unsettled a priest.

choices.label: Wrestle your soul out of the plastic carrier bag
choices.win: Your soul is free. The bag tears. The shop charges you for two bags.
choices.lose: Your soul has developed handles. The till asks if you need help carrying it.

onWin.memory: You recovered your soul from a carrier bag and were charged double for packaging.

scenes.text: Your client refuses to answer unless you honk first. The arresting officer says the goose issued seventeen parking fines and one declaration of war.

choices.label: Learn enough Goose to establish privilege
choices.win: The goose confesses everything under legal privilege. You immediately regret understanding it.
choices.lose: Your honk is legally a guilty plea. You begin drafting an appeal.

onWin.memory: You learned Goose and immediately acquired seventeen confidential regrets.

choices.label: Purchase an official interpreter and a bag of bread
choices.hint: A guaranteed interview; bread remains privileged evidence.
choices.win: The interpreter translates 'honk' as 'my learned friend'. It sounds expensive.
choices.lose: No interpreter is available.

onWin.memory: You hired a goose interpreter who billed every honk separately.

choices.label: Read all seventeen disputed parking fines
choices.win: They are valid. The goose is annoyingly good at municipal law.
choices.lose: Fine eighteen appears on your boot.

onWin.memory: You discovered the goose's parking fines were legally impeccable.

scenes.text: The evidence locker is full of stolen mayoral hats. Every hat fits the goose. One has already endorsed its re-election.

choices.label: Cross-examine the partisan hat
choices.win: Under pressure, the hat admits it endorses anyone with a head.
choices.lose: It claims parliamentary immunity and lands on the judge.

onWin.memory: You exposed a mayoral hat's indiscriminate electoral endorsements.

choices.label: Measure the goose without losing a finger
choices.win: The measurements match the former mayor exactly. Especially the beak.
choices.lose: The goose adds attempted tailoring to your invoice.

onWin.memory: Your client's beak measurements matched the former mayor.

scenes.text: The ghost waves a receipt the length of its unfulfilled life. It only wanted milk. Every three feet is a survey asking how the haunting went.

choices.label: Identify the unfinished transaction
choices.win: A coupon expired at the exact moment of death. An unusually literal outstanding balance.
choices.lose: The receipt prints a receipt for your investigation. It is longer.

onWin.memory: The checkout ghost died with an expired milk coupon unresolved.

choices.label: Pay off the ghost's milk debt
choices.hint: End the dispute over milk; face the supervisor next.
choices.win: The ghost can finally move on. Unfortunately, store policy requires supervisor approval.
choices.lose: The till refuses payment.

onWin.memory: You paid an undead shopper's outstanding milk debt.

choices.label: Lift the till away from the possessed counter
choices.win: The ghost follows the plug. Your diagnosis is correct and inconvenient.
choices.lose: The counter is also possessed. They are married.

onLose.memory: You discovered the haunted till and counter were married.

scenes.text: The supervisor appears from a door marked 'Staff Only, Living or Otherwise'. She asks why your exorcism has not scanned as a vegetable.

choices.label: Explain the difference between a spirit and a sprout
choices.win: She updates the training manual. It is now both longer and haunted.
choices.lose: She weighs your soul on the produce scale.

onWin.memory: You corrected the shop's spirit-versus-sprout training manual.

choices.label: Endure the mandatory customer experience questionnaire
choices.win: Twenty pages. The ghost crosses over out of respect.
choices.lose: Question twenty-one asks if you would recommend being dead.

onWin.memory: You completed a twenty-page questionnaire during an exorcism.

scenes.text: This dragon keeps its wealth offshore. Literally: the hoard is on a raft, three feet beyond the tax inspector's shoes. The tide is coming in.

choices.label: Reclassify the raft as a mobile pension
choices.win: The inspector boards it for valuation. The pension becomes extremely mobile.
choices.lose: The raft is now liable for road tax. Nobody understands why.

onWin.memory: You registered a floating dragon hoard as a mobile pension.

choices.label: Retrieve the gold without sinking the jurisdiction
choices.win: Hoard ashore. The dragon mourns the golden age of fiscal freedom.
choices.lose: You sink through a loophole. A literal one in the raft.

onLose.memory: You fell through a dragon's literal tax loophole.

choices.label: Buy waterproof filing boxes before the tide wins
choices.hint: Secure evidence; preparation +1 in the tax-return finale.
choices.win: The evidence floats. A small, infuriating triumph for accountancy.
choices.lose: The boxes are unavailable.

onWin.memory: Waterproof filing boxes saved the dragon's offshore accounts.

scenes.text: Tonight's soup has formed a political party. Its manifesto demands bowls with exits and representation for bisques. The chef has called an emergency ladle meeting.

choices.label: Help the soup organise a peaceful walkout
choices.win: The soup flows out in single file. The chowder supplies a brass band.
choices.lose: A chowder faction disputes the route and blocks the pass.

onWin.memory: You organised a soup walkout with a chowder brass band.

choices.label: Print waterproof campaign leaflets
choices.hint: Fund the campaign; the argument still has to be won.
choices.win: 'A future with less ladling.' It polls well among liquids.
choices.lose: The printer is closed.

onWin.memory: You printed waterproof election leaflets for an anti-ladling soup party.

choices.label: Stand between the soup and the bread patrol
choices.win: The bread patrol retreats, slightly soggy.
choices.lose: A baguette makes an unnecessarily firm point.

onLose.memory: A bread patrol used a baguette against your soup campaign.

scenes.text: The televised debate is between soup and a roast potato. The potato's platform is 'be quiet and get eaten'. It is leading among chefs.

choices.label: Ask the potato a question outside its briefing
choices.win: The potato cannot answer a question about gravy rights. Its support crumbles.
choices.lose: It answers with devastating simplicity: 'Butter.' The crowd roars.

onWin.memory: You exposed a roast potato's weak policy on gravy rights.

choices.label: Remind the audience what happened to yesterday's soup
choices.win: A difficult silence. Even the potato looks down.
choices.lose: The chef calls that a positive customer testimonial.

onWin.memory: Yesterday's soup became the moral centre of a televised debate.

scenes.text: The tower's support line plays one lute note. After two hours a voice says, 'For security reasons, please describe the note you have been holding.'

choices.label: Transcribe the note into an arcane support ticket
choices.win: Ticket accepted. The note was secretly the password, with excellent job security.
choices.lose: You have described B flat. The tower regards that as an insult.

onWin.memory: You discovered a wizard's support hold note was the password.

choices.label: Stay on hold until a human answers
choices.win: A human answers. They have forgotten why they work here. You bond.
choices.lose: The hold music gains a second note. It is worse.

onWin.memory: You reached a real human at the wizard's tower support line.

choices.label: Ask the lute player for a quiet hint
choices.win: The musician slips you the chord chart. It is marked 'confidential'.
choices.lose: The musician forwards you to percussion. A mallet answers.

onWin.memory: A support-line lute player leaked a confidential chord chart.
